create.title: Create Integration
create.empty: No integration types are currently available.

mqtt_private.label: Private MQTT
mqtt_private.description: Customizable-scope forwarding of all or some messages to an MQTT broker of your choosing, in raw and/or decrypted form.

mqtt_ha.label: Home Assistant MQTT Discovery
mqtt_ha.description: Publishes MQTT Discovery payloads so mesh devices appear natively in Home Assistant. Requires HA's built-in MQTT integration connected to the same broker. Select specific contacts for GPS tracking and repeaters for telemetry sensors.

mqtt_community.label: Community MQTT/meshcoretomqtt
mqtt_community.description: MeshcoreToMQTT-compatible raw-packet feed publishing, compatible with community aggregators (in other words, make your companion radio also serve as an observer node). Superset of other Community MQTT presets.

mqtt_community_meshrank.label: MeshRank
mqtt_community_meshrank.description: A community MQTT config preconfigured for MeshRank, requiring only the provided topic from your MeshRank configuration. A subset of the primary Community MQTT/meshcoretomqtt configuration; you are free to edit all configuration after creation.

mqtt_community_letsmesh_us.label: LetsMesh (US)
mqtt_community_letsmesh_us.description: A community MQTT config preconfigured for the LetsMesh US-ingest endpoint, requiring only your email and IATA region code. Good to use with an additional EU configuration for redundancy. A subset of the primary Community MQTT/meshcoretomqtt configuration; you are free to edit all configuration after creation.

mqtt_community_letsmesh_eu.label: LetsMesh (EU)
mqtt_community_letsmesh_eu.description: A community MQTT config preconfigured for the LetsMesh EU-ingest endpoint, requiring only your email and IATA region code. Good to use with an additional US configuration for redundancy. A subset of the primary Community MQTT/meshcoretomqtt configuration; you are free to edit all configuration after creation.

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.description: Generic webhook for decrypted channel/DM messages with customizable verb, method, and optional HMAC signature.

apprise.label: Apprise
apprise.description: A wide-ranging generic fanout, capable of forwarding decrypted channel/DM messages to Discord, Telegram, email, SMS, and many others.

sqs.label: Amazon SQS
sqs.description: Send full or scope-customized raw or decrypted packets to an SQS

map_upload.label: Map Upload
map_upload.description: Upload repeaters and room servers to map.meshcore.io or a compatible map API endpoint.

toast.missingId: Missing fanout config id for update

list.experimentalBanner: Integrations are an experimental feature in open beta, and allow you to fanout raw and decrypted messages across multiple services for automation, analysis, or archiving.
list.name: Name
list.errorDescription: Most recent backend error retained for this integration.
list.botsMoved: Bots are now extensions. Add or review them in Settings > Extensions; the bundled “Echo” extension (meshloom.echo) is the example to start from.

mqtt.privateHelp: Forward mesh data to your own MQTT broker for home automation, logging, or alerting.
mqtt.outgoingWarning: Outgoing messages (DMs and group messages) will be reported to private MQTT brokers in decrypted/plaintext form.

ha.title: Home Assistant MQTT Discovery
ha.help: Publish discovery configs and MeshCore state to your MQTT broker so Home Assistant creates native devices, sensors, GPS trackers, and message events automatically.
ha.step1Help: Home Assistant's built-in MQTT integration must point at the same broker configured below.
ha.step2Help: Choose repeaters for telemetry sensors and contacts for GPS tracker entities.
ha.step3Help: Radio health and message events publish continuously; repeater and contact data update when new data is heard or collected.
ha.usesDiscovery: Uses <discovery>MQTT Discovery</discovery> and the topic conventions documented in <readme>README_HA.md</readme>.
ha.whatGetsCreated: What gets created in Home Assistant
ha.perRepeaterHelp: — updates on telemetry collect cycle (~8h) or manual dashboard fetch. Entity IDs shown use one repeater for example; these sensors are created for each selected repeater.
ha.perContactHelp: — updates passively when advertisements with GPS are heard, and from any GPS reading in the contact's CayenneLPP telemetry. Shown for one contact; a tracker is created for each selected contact.
ha.trackerHelp: — latitude/longitude (plus altitude when telemetry provides it)
ha.contactLpp: , etc. — CayenneLPP sensors (when the contact is tracked for telemetry; GPS goes to the tracker above)
ha.messageEventsFires: — fires for each message matching the scope below
ha.messageEventsTrigger: — trigger automations on sender, channel, or message content
ha.entityIdsHelp: Entity IDs use the first 12 characters of the node's public key. Entities are removed from HA when this integration is disabled or deleted. State topics are published under {{prefix}}/<node_id>/health|telemetry|gps.
ha.topicSummaryHelp: Home Assistant device and entity IDs are keyed off the first 12 characters of each node's public key, not the display name. Those same 12 characters are used in the MQTT state topics below.
ha.noTopicPreviews: No topic previews available yet. Connect to a radio to resolve the local radio key, and select contacts or repeaters above to preview their published topics.
ha.discoveryTopics: Discovery config topics are also published under homeassistant/.../config, but the topics above are the primary runtime state and event topics.
ha.topicPrefixHelp: State updates publish under {{prefix}}/. Discovery configs always use the homeassistant/ prefix.
ha.gpsHelp: Each selected contact becomes a device_tracker in HA, updated whenever an advertisement with GPS coordinates is heard. Useful for tracking mobile nodes on an HA map dashboard.
ha.telemetryHelp: Each selected repeater becomes an HA device with sensors for battery voltage, RSSI, SNR, noise floor, packet counts, and uptime. Data updates whenever telemetry is collected (auto-collect runs every ~8 hours, or on manual dashboard fetch). Only repeaters already in the auto-telemetry tracking list appear here (add new repeaters by logging into the repeater and opting in at the bottom of the page).
ha.noTrackedRepeaters: No repeaters are being auto-tracked for telemetry. Add repeaters to the auto-telemetry tracking list in the Radio section first, then return here to select which ones to expose to HA.
ha.trackedNotFound: Auto-tracked repeaters not found in contact list.
ha.messageEventsHelp: Matching messages fire an {{entity}} entity in HA with sender, text, channel, and direction attributes. Use HA automations to trigger actions on specific messages, channels, or contacts.

community.help: Advanced community MQTT editor. Use this for manual meshcoretomqtt-compatible setups or for modifying a saved preset after creation. Only raw RF packets are shared — never decrypted messages.
community.wsPathHelp: Defaults to / — use /mqtt for brokers that require a path
community.tokenAudienceHelp: Defaults to the broker host when blank
community.ownerEmailHelp: Used to claim your node on the community aggregator

meshrank.help: Pre-filled MeshRank setup. This saves as a regular Community MQTT integration once created, but only asks for the MeshRank packet topic you were given.
meshrank.brokerSummary: Broker {{host}} on port {{port}} via {{transport}}, auth {{auth}}, TLS on, certificate verification on, region code fixed to {{iata}}.
meshrank.topicHelp: Paste the full topic template from your MeshRank config, for example meshrank/uplink/B435F6D5F7896B74C6B995FE221C2C1F/{PUBLIC_KEY}/packets.

letsmesh.help: Pre-filled LetsMesh setup. This saves as a regular Community MQTT integration once created, but only asks for the values LetsMesh expects from you.
letsmesh.brokerSummary: Broker {{host}} on port {{port}} via {{transport}}, auth {{auth}}, TLS on, certificate verification on, token audience fixed to {{host}}.

map.help: Automatically upload heard repeater and room server advertisements to map.meshcore.io. Requires the radio's private key to be available (firmware must have ENABLE_PRIVATE_KEY_EXPORT=1). Only raw RF packets are shared — never decrypted messages.
map.dryRunStatusOn: Dry Run is ON. No uploads will be sent. Check the backend logs to verify the payload looks correct before enabling live sends.
map.dryRunStatusOff: Dry Run is OFF. Live uploads are enabled. Each advert is rate-limited to once per hour per node.
map.dryRunHelp: When enabled, upload payloads are logged at INFO level but not sent. Disable once you have confirmed the logged output looks correct.
map.apiUrlHelp: Leave blank to use the default map.meshcore.io endpoint.
map.geofenceHelp: Only upload nodes whose location falls within the configured radius of your radio's own position. Helps exclude nodes with false or spoofed coordinates. Uses the latitude/longitude set in Radio Settings.
map.noCoords: Your radio does not currently have a latitude/longitude configured. Geofencing will be silently skipped until coordinates are set in Settings → Radio → Location.
map.usingPosition: Using radio position {{lat}}, {{lon}} as the geofence center. Update coordinates in Radio Settings to move the center.
map.radiusHelp: Nodes further than this distance from your radio's position will not be uploaded.

scope.title: Message Scope
scope.emptyWarning: Nothing is selected — this integration will not forward any data.
scope.onlyHint: Newly added channels or contacts will not be automatically included.
scope.exceptHint: Newly added channels or contacts will be automatically included unless excluded here.
scope.hidePills: >{{max}} selections made; hiding selection preview to keep the interface clean

apprise.help: Send push notifications via <apprise>Apprise</apprise> when messages are received. Supports Discord, Slack, Telegram, email, and <services>100+ other services</services>.
apprise.urlsHelp: One URL per line. All URLs receive every matched notification. For Matrix room version 12 (servername-less room IDs), append ?hsreq=no to the URL.
apprise.preserveIdentityHelp: When enabled, Discord webhooks will use their configured name/avatar instead of overriding with MeshCore sender info.
apprise.includeOutgoingHelp: Include DMs and channel messages sent by this Meshloom instance, including manual sends and extension replies. Outgoing messages carry no routing path or signal data, so path-related format fields render as direct and RSSI/SNR are empty.
apprise.markdownHelp: If notifications fail on services like Telegram due to special characters in sender names, disable this option.
apprise.varHopsBackticked: Hops wrapped in backticks for markdown
apprise.varsFooter: Empty textareas use the default format. RSSI/SNR may be empty if unavailable.

webhook.help: Send message data as JSON to an HTTP endpoint when messages are received.
webhook.hmacHelp: When a secret is set, each request includes an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the JSON body in the specified header (e.g. sha256=ab12cd...).

sqs.help: Send matched mesh events to an Amazon SQS queue for durable processing by workers, Lambdas, or downstream automation.
sqs.warning: Outgoing messages and any selected raw packets will be delivered exactly as forwarded by the fanout scope, including decrypted/plaintext message content.
sqs.endpointHelp: Useful for LocalStack or custom endpoints
sqs.staticCredsHelp: Leave blank to use the server's normal AWS credential chain.
